title: Configuration codec positions
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean alphabet and natural numbers $n$ and $s$, a codec position is a pair consisting of an input-head position among $n+2$ positions and, for each of the $M$'s work tapes, a position among $2s+1$ positions.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
